# IzradaWebSajta.co

> Web development agency from Belgrade, Serbia (Just 4 you d.o.o, since 2016, 500+
> delivered projects). Websites, e-commerce, custom software, mobile apps and AI
> solutions for clients in Serbia, Europe and the US. Guaranteed delivery date:
> the deadline in the quote is the delivery deadline. Site is bilingual: Serbian
> (/sr/) and English (/en/).

Prices start from: business website €500, corporate €800, e-commerce €1,000,
custom CMS platform €3,000, custom software €3,000, mobile app €4,500,
AI chatbot €500 + €50/month. Free quote within 24h: https://izradawebsajta.co/en/contact/
